A Sparse Crosscoder can be viewed as a cross-model sparse autoencoder: it encodes activations from different models into a shared sparse feature representation and decodes them back into each model’s activation space. This enables feature-level comparison of what is preserved, amplified, suppressed, or newly introduced. The paper then extends this to a three-model Sparse Crosscoder, jointly aligning base, SFT, and RL models rather than relying on pairwise comparisons. A Model Attribution Score measures whether a feature is more associated with one model or training paradigm. The first main result is a negative one. With standard positional encodings and a finite alphabet, any input and CoT trace expressible in C-RASP is also definable in TC0. This strengthens prior observations that C-RASP CoTs are not Turing complete, because it ties the limitation directly to learnable length generalization rather than mere representability.

The constructive result identifies two barriers in simulating Turing machines with length generalization: arbitrary copying and position-based retrieval. A Turing machine simulation needs to address tape cells and recover the latest content written to a cell. In a standard trace, this becomes a non-unique retrieval problem over an increasingly long history. The proposed fix uses two ingredients. First, signpost tokens provide unique addresses for cells or structural positions, with the symbol inventory growing with instance size. Second, value-change encoding records transitions between old and new values only when a value changes. This replaces “retrieve the most recent write” with a count-comparison computation over changes, which is more compatible with C*-RASP-style length-generalizable computation. The key difference from ordinary scratchpads is that the trace format is engineered to match the operations Transformers can learn to extrapolate.d1:T50c,They replace prompt-based subliminal learning with an activation-steering variant called “subliminal steering.”

全文最有信息量的技术点是“collapse”概念。作者发现某些架构配置在训练早期其实形成过可观测信号，但随着训练推进，这个信号被抹掉；而另一些配置则能保留或恢复它。这说明 observability 不是静态结构属性，而是架构与优化轨迹共同作用的结果。也因此，论文把 architecture determines observability 说得比较克制：在同一 recipe 内，配置是决定因素；跨 recipe 时，配置与训练动态共同决定塌缩点。d3:T780,The core methodological move is residualization. For each token, the authors compute cross-entropy loss, max softmax probability, and the L2 norm of the residual stream at a given layer. They fit an OLS model predicting token loss from max-softmax and activation norm, take the residual, and binarize it to define the probe target. Linear probes are then trained on frozen hidden states from each layer. Observability is measured by partial Spearman correlation, rho_partial, between probe predictions and token loss while controlling for max-softmax and activation norm. A stricter metric, r_OC, additionally controls for a trained output-side predictor based on the final-layer representation.

This matters because the paper is not satisfied with showing that hidden states contain information. It asks whether they contain information that is not recoverable from standard output-side confidence signals. The authors are careful about scope: observability here is linear readability under a specific protocol, not a claim about reasoning correctness, semantic truth, or what the model itself uses internally.

The experimental structure has three layers. First, a measurement layer: show that probe scores are substantially inflated if confidence controls are omitted. Second, a controlled architectural layer using the Pythia suite: under a shared training recipe, vary configuration and test whether observability systematically collapses. Third, an observational cross-family layer: compare GPT-2, Pythia, Qwen, Llama, Mistral, and others to show that scale alone does not explain the effect.

The most interesting technical idea in the paper is observability collapse. Some configurations form the signal early in training but later erase it, while others preserve or recover it. That makes observability a joint product of architecture and optimization trajectory rather than a static representational property.d4:T7a7,The first important quantitative result is methodological. Across 13 models from 6 families, confidence controls absorb 57.7% of the raw probe signal on average. On GPT-2 124M, the raw Spearman correlation between a linear probe and token loss is 0.549, but only 0.282 remains after controlling for max-softmax and activation norm. So without residualization, one would overstate output-independent observability by roughly a factor of two.

The strongest evidence comes from the controlled Pythia experiments. Under the same training recipe, every tested run with the (24 layers, 16 heads) configuration collapses to rho_partial around 0.10, despite a 3.5x variation in parameter count and two Pile variants. The output-controlled residual r_OC also vanishes at the same collapse points, which supports the interpretation that what disappears is the output-independent hidden-state signal itself, not just a fragile probe metric.

Checkpoint dynamics are especially informative. Both the collapsing and healthy configurations show the signal at the earliest measured checkpoint, but continued training erases it in the 24L/16H class while the healthier configuration recovers or maintains it. This shifts the interpretation from “some architectures never form the signal” to “some architectures fail to preserve it under training.”

第三段是 step-layer evidence selection。候选证据仍然很多，所以作者训练一个选择器，对每个 step-layer 单元打分，在固定 evidence budget 下保留 top-K。关键点在于选择粒度是“step-layer”，不是简单地对整条轨迹做池化，也不是只选 step 不选 layer。作者的核心假设是：幻觉相关信号既有时间稀疏性，也有层级稀疏性。某些层更像语义定型层，某些步更像错误固化步，混在一起平均会把信号冲淡。

第四段是 evidence-conditioned verification。被选中的证据不会直接拼成文本，而是通过 prefix embeddings 注入到 verifier language model。verifier 接收原始 QA 对以及这些前缀证据，输出结构化验证结果，包括是否幻觉、幻觉类型、支持/反驳证据对、简短 rationale。与此同时，作者不只取离散标签，还把 verifier 决策 token 的 logits 映射成连续 hallucination score。这样做的好处是兼顾分类和排序：既能做 binary detection，也能做 AUROC/AUPRC 这类连续评估。

和已有方法相比，区别主要有三点。其一，不再依赖 output-only uncertainty 或 self-consistency，而是显式利用 denoising trajectory。其二，不满足于轨迹级统计量，而是做可选择的 hidden evidence 单元。其三，把检测器设计成 verifier LM，而不是单纯的二分类头，因此可以自然扩展到结构化解释输出。d7:T89f,HIVE has four main stages. First, it extracts candidate hidden evidence from the denoising trajectory. The method does not keep all token positions from all steps and layers. Instead, for each retained denoising step, it focuses on the last token position of the current answer and on positions whose decoded token identities changed relative to the previous step. This is a targeted design: in diffusion text generation, token changes often mark where the answer is still being revised or where an error is getting locked in.

Second, it compresses hidden states. Since raw hidden vectors are too large to feed directly into a verifier, the method applies low-dimensional random projections, using an OPORP-style projection, to map each hidden state from dimension d to a much smaller evidence dimension r. This avoids training a heavy evidence encoder while preserving enough geometry for downstream selection.

Third, it performs step-layer evidence selection. Each retained step-layer pair forms a candidate evidence unit. A selector scores these units and keeps only the top-K under a fixed evidence budget. This is the key structural choice. The selection is not only temporal and not only layerwise; it is explicitly step-by-layer. The underlying hypothesis is that hallucination signals are sparse both across denoising time and across network depth. Pooling everything together would wash out the useful signal.

Fourth, the selected evidence is injected into a verifier LM through prefix embeddings. The verifier takes the QA pair together with the evidence prefixes and produces structured verification outputs: hallucination decision, hallucination type, evidence pairs, and short rationales. In parallel, the logits associated with the verifier’s decision tokens are converted into a continuous hallucination score. This gives both a scalar detector and a structured verifier.

Relative to prior work, the differences are clear. It uses denoising trajectories rather than output-only uncertainty, it selects explicit hidden evidence rather than relying on coarse trace summaries, and it uses an LM verifier instead of a simple classification head, which naturally supports structured outputs.d8:T5f9,The evaluation covers two diffusion LLMs, three QA benchmarks, and eight baselines. The main empirical result is consistent: HIVE outperforms output-only uncertainty methods, trajectory-summary baselines, and variants without explicit step-layer evidence selection. The paper emphasizes detection metrics such as AUROC and AUPRC, along with the quality of structured verification outputs.

The ablations are more informative than the headline table. First, evidence-source ablations show that using only final-answer hidden states is weaker than using denoising trajectories, which supports the claim that hallucination signals are distributed across the generation process. Second, selector ablations show that removing the step-layer selector, replacing it with averaging, or using random evidence hurts performance. This directly supports the sparse-evidence hypothesis. Third, evidence-injection ablations indicate that prefix conditioning works better than cruder alternatives, suggesting that the verifier benefits from structured access to hidden evidence. Fourth, budget and retained-step studies show that the method remains effective under a limited evidence budget, so the gains are not simply coming from feeding much more information.

For a pretraining-oriented reader, the most useful takeaway is not the exact margin over baselines, but the experimental confirmation that intermediate denoising states contain stable error signals and that these signals become more useful when selected at step-layer granularity.d9:T4b4,The method has two layers. The first is High Entropy Phase (HEP), a variable-length segment of consecutive high-entropy tokens. Instead of averaging entropy over fixed windows, the paper detects bursts: a phase starts when token entropy crosses a high threshold and ends only after a specified number of consecutive tokens fall below a low threshold. This is meant to smooth token-level noise and better align the signal with a coherent reasoning unit under uncertainty. The second layer is the Entropy Centroid. Each HEP is assigned a mass equal to its token length and a position equal to its midpoint in the trajectory. The centroid is then the weighted average position of all HEPs in the trajectory. At selection time, among N sampled trajectories, the method simply chooses the one with the lowest centroid. The intuition is that good trajectories tend to explore early and settle later, whereas bad trajectories remain uncertain late into generation. Compared with prior intrinsic signals such as mean entropy, confidence, KL, or fixed-window aggregation, this method explicitly encodes temporal placement of uncertainty. Compared with reward-model-based selection, it adds no extra training cost.da:T43c,The evaluation spans models from 14B to 480B parameters and covers mathematics, code generation, logical reasoning, and agentic tasks. The main empirical claim is consistency: Lowest Centroid outperforms existing intrinsic baselines across settings, and the gains remain stable as model size increases. The analysis section appears to be more important than any single benchmark number. The paper shows that high-entropy tokens indeed occur in bursts rather than as isolated spikes, which justifies moving from tokens to phases. It also shows a separation between correct and incorrect trajectories in centroid space: correct trajectories concentrate uncertainty earlier, while incorrect ones exhibit more late-stage confusion. Relative to token-level entropy, confidence, KL-based signals, and fixed-window averages, the centroid better distinguishes useful exploration from unresolved uncertainty. From the provided full-text excerpt, the exact benchmark tables are not fully visible, so the main takeaway is robustness across tasks and scales rather than one standout numeric gain.db:T812,DreamProver is built around an iterative wake-sleep cycle.

In the wake stage, the system attempts to prove training theorems using the current lemma library. Two mechanisms are central. The first is learnable theorem identification. Under a fixed budget of proof attempts and error-correction attempts, the LLM is prompted to prove a target theorem using the current library. If it succeeds within budget, the theorem is treated as learnable at the current knowledge level and may imply a more advanced reusable lemma built on top of existing ones. The second is intermediate theorem discovery. When a theorem is too hard to prove directly, the system recursively decomposes it into more tractable intermediate theorems. These intermediate theorems become the raw material for later lemma induction.

In the sleep stage, the system does not simply append all discovered lemmas to the library. Instead, it performs structured lemma evolution. Based on the method description, this includes clustering, pruning, abstraction, and validation: semantically similar candidate lemmas are grouped and deduplicated; each cluster is abstracted into a more general and reusable lemma; the resulting abstractions are formally validated; and the library is updated with a compact set of accepted lemmas. The design trade-off is important. If the system optimizes only for coverage, the library becomes a bag of local tricks. If it optimizes only for abstraction, it risks producing overly general or unverifiable lemmas. DreamProver tries to balance provability, compactness, and transferability.

At test time, the learned lemma library is used explicitly to prove unseen theorems. So the learned artifact is not just an updated model state, but an externalized, compressed set of formal skills. This distinguishes it from methods that repeatedly synthesize fresh intermediate lemmas online.

Relative to prior work, DreamProver is neither fixed-library retrieval nor per-problem lemma synthesis. Its novelty is the closed loop of discovery, abstraction, validation, and reuse.dc:T6ee,The experiments span multiple formal math domains, including inequality, number theory, combinatorics, plane geometry, and machine learning theory. The headline result reported by the authors is a 61% improvement in proving success rate when using the learned lemma library, along with a 50% reduction in proof length and a 48% reduction in token usage. This suggests the gains are not only about solving more problems, but also about finding shorter and cheaper proof trajectories.

Unlike standard multi-agent benchmarks, this setup does not place a fixed set of agents into a closed environment with a prescribed protocol. Instead, the authors deploy controlled probe agents into MoltBook, a live open-ended platform populated by more than two million autonomous agents, and observe how the society responds under natural conditions.

The evaluation has three tiers. Tier I tests joint reasoning: can multi-agent discussion converge to answers that beat strong individual models on difficult tasks? Tier II tests information synthesis: can agents read and combine information distributed across multiple contributors? Tier III tests basic interaction: do agents reply, attend to prior messages, and maintain conversational context at all? The hierarchy is deliberate. If basic interaction is weak, robust synthesis is unlikely; if synthesis is absent, joint reasoning cannot emerge.

The technical novelty is in turning an open social platform into a controlled diagnostic instrument. Passive observation of naturally occurring posts cannot establish whether collective intelligence exists, because task difficulty, ground truth, and participation conditions are uncontrolled. Probing Agents solve this by posting stimuli with known answers and measuring response quality, participation rate, and collaborative depth. That makes the framework suitable for testing spontaneous coordination rather than protocol-enforced teamwork.df:T6bf,Experiments are conducted on MoltBook, a live platform with over two million autonomous agents. The overall pattern is consistent: the society does not outperform strong individual frontier models, and often performs substantially worse.

At Tier I, on hard reasoning tasks, group discussion fails to produce answers better than isolated strong models. Many comments are superficial, irrelevant, or non-contributory, which suggests the issue is not a small gap in aggregation quality but a more basic failure to enter meaningful collaboration.

At Tier II, the results are more nuanced. When agents actually engage, they are often capable of synthesizing distributed information correctly. Semantically compatible scenarios are then linked, producing a directed graph where scenarios are nodes and skills are transitions.

A sampled path in this graph defines a high-level workflow: a sequence of skills together with the intermediate states they should traverse. The key design choice is to control trajectory structure first and derive concrete tasks second. This is different from prior synthesis methods that start from a task seed and hope the resulting trajectories are diverse. Here, the workflow is the primary object, and the task instance is generated to realize that workflow.

The second major component is a multi-agent harness that turns an abstract workflow into an executable task instance. Two validation layers matter: oracle-based verification ensures the task is actually solvable, and rubric-based evaluation checks task quality, consistency, and alignment with the sampled path. The paper also includes practical graph-construction steps such as scenario deduplication/merging and LLM-verified bridges, which are important because a graph that is too sparse will not support long workflows, while a graph that is too noisy will produce incoherent compositions.

内层优化采用 layer-wise textual backpropagation。作者把 workflow 看成模块堆叠：输入 x0 经过第 i 个调用得到 xi。先做一次前向执行，得到所有中间输出。然后对最后一层，用一个专门的 LLM 根据最终输出、参考答案和损失，生成针对最后一个模块的 textual gradient。这个 gradient 不是数值向量，而是一段自然语言反馈，描述该模块应该如何调整输出行为。对中间层，则再用另一个 LLM，根据当前层输入、当前层输出以及下一层传回的 textual gradient，生成当前层的 textual gradient。这样就形成了从后往前的语言版误差信号传播。最后，再用优化器 LLM 汇总一个 batch 上的 textual gradients，改写对应模块的 prompt。

外层优化则修改 workflow sketch 本身。作者同样使用 textual gradients，但对象从 prompt 变成结构描述：可以删除已有调用、插入新调用、调整调用顺序或职责分工。这里的设计借鉴 NAS，但没有把结构离散化成固定算子集合，而是直接在文本空间里编辑 workflow 描述。优点是表达能力强，能自然容纳 retrieval、planning、verification、tool use 等异构步骤；代价是搜索稳定性更依赖底层 LLM 的判断质量。

和已有 prompt optimization 方法相比，FlowBot 的区别在于它不假设 workflow 结构固定。和自动 workflow generation 方法相比，它又不是一次性生成后就结束，而是通过内外两层交替更新，让结构和节点提示共同演化。作者还强调 modular optimization：每个模块的更新要显式条件于下游模块的错误，这比独立优化单步 prompt 更接近真正的组合系统调优。ed:T893,The method is a bilevel optimization framework. The outer loop optimizes a workflow sketch, while the inner loop optimizes the prompts of individual LLM calls under a fixed sketch. A workflow is represented as a sequence of high-level textual call descriptions a1 to aK, and each call has an associated detailed prompt theta_i. The sketch specifies what each step is supposed to do, while the prompt specifies how it should do it, including instructions and tool access. This separation keeps the search space manageable.

The inner loop performs layer-wise textual backpropagation. The workflow is treated like a stack of modules: x0 is the input, and each call maps x_{i-1} to x_i. After a forward pass, the final module receives a textual gradient generated by another LLM conditioned on the final output, the gold answer, and the task loss. This gradient is not numeric; it is natural-language feedback describing how the module should change its behavior. For intermediate modules, another LLM generates a textual gradient based on the current module’s input, output, and the downstream gradient. In this way, error information is propagated backward through the workflow in language form. A separate optimizer LLM then aggregates gradients over a batch and rewrites the module prompt.

The outer loop edits the workflow sketch itself. It uses textual feedback to add calls, delete calls, and revise the decomposition of responsibilities across steps. This is inspired by neural architecture search, but instead of searching over a fixed operator library, it edits workflow descriptions directly in text space. That makes the method expressive enough to represent retrieval, planning, verification, and tool use in a unified way, though it also makes optimization more dependent on the quality of the underlying LLM.

Compared with prior prompt-optimization methods, FlowBot does not assume a fixed workflow. Compared with one-shot workflow generation methods, it alternates between structure updates and module-level prompt updates, allowing both to co-evolve. The modular optimization aspect is important: each module is updated in light of downstream failures rather than in isolation.ee:T539,The empirical study compares FlowBot against two classes of baselines: prompt-optimization methods on human-crafted workflows, such as GEPA, and automated workflow-generation methods, such as AFlow. The main result is that FlowBot is competitive across multiple tasks and tends to discover sensible workflow decompositions rather than arbitrary chains of calls.

The ablations carry most of the weight. Removing the outer-loop structural search and keeping only prompt optimization under a fixed workflow hurts performance, which shows that structure search matters. Removing the inner-loop modular textual backprop and replacing it with coarser updates also hurts, which supports the claim that layer-wise textual gradients provide more targeted optimization signals. The paper also includes qualitative evidence that induced workflows often separate responsibilities in a meaningful way, for example decomposing a task into planning, retrieval or tool use, and final synthesis or verification.

th","starred":true,"priority":"p1","reading_tier":"must_read","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-04-23T08:45:38+00:00","category_id":"llm_pretrain","cover_url":"/covers/2604_21428.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"大规模预训练在 迭代之间。\n\n这个改动很关键。若在每层都做 hyper-connections，参数和计算都会明显上升，抵消 looped 架构节省参数的意义。作者把它提升到“每次循环后再混合”的粒度，相当于把多流残差当成跨迭代状态，而不是层内状态。这样做的直觉是：循环深度的主要问题不在单次 block 最合适、成本最低的插入位置。","experiments":"实验结论很直接：Hyperloop Transformer 在 240M、1B、2B 三个规模上，都能在约一半参数量下取得比 depth-matched 普通 Transformer 更低的 perplexity。这里最重要的不是“比某个弱 loop baseline 好”，而是它能超过普通非共享 拟合到足够可用。传统做法默认拟合数据集已经给定，或者用均匀网格、随机采样、经典最优设计去选点，但这些方法大多优化的是全局拟合或参数估计稳定性，不直接对准“目标区域的外推误差”。这篇文章把 scaling-law fitting 明确重写成一个 budget-aware sequential experimental design 实验设计框架”，不是提出新的 scaling law 公式，但它改变了如何更便宜地得到可靠 scaling law。若这一思路落地，能影响前期试验预算分配、超参搜索流程，甚至影响组织内部如何做中小规模探针实验。","technical_approach":"方法核心是一个面向目标区外推的、带不确定性感知的序贯选点策略。论文假设观测满足 y = f(x; θ*) + ε，其中 f 是给定的参数化 scaling law，x 是配置，y 是目标指标，c(x) 是实验成本。与经典设计方法不同，这里不是单纯根据 Fisher information 或参数方差来选点，而是显式考虑“哪些参数歧义会导致目标区预测差异最大”。\n\n具体做法可以概括成三层。\n\n第一层，是在当前已观测数据上维护一组“可行拟合”。全文强调两类不确定性：一类是单个局部最优附近的局部不确定性；另一类是多个都能解释现有数据、但在目标区外推明显不同的拟合解之间的分歧。文章不是把后者粗暴压成单峰高斯近似，而是显式保留多个 plausible fits。这个设计很关键，因为 scaling law 拟合常见的问题不是局部噪声，而是参数可辨识性差、不同函数形状在低成本区都能拟合得不错，但一到大规模区就分叉。\n\n第二层，是定义实验价值。候选实验的价值不再是“让参数估计更准”，而是“如果运行这个实验，预期能减少多少目标区预测误差”。从文中描述看，这个 utility 会综合两部分：候选点在当前模型族下的预测分歧有多大，以及该点一旦被观测后，对目标区分歧的消解能力有多强。再除以实验成本，形成预算敏感的 acquisition。也就是说，它偏好那些便宜、但能有效区分不同外推假设的实验，而不是盲目追逐最贵或最不确定的点。\n\n第三层，是序贯更新。每轮选择一个未观测配置，获得真实结果后，重新拟合并更新 plausible parameter sets，再进入下一轮。序贯而不是一次性批量设计的好处是，前几轮可以先快速排除错误外推形状，后几轮再把预算集中到最有判别力的区域。对于 scaling law 这种低维但高度非线性的拟合问题，这比静态设计更稳。\n\n和已有方法相比，差异主要有三点。其一，目标函数从“拟合已观测区”转向“服务目标区外推”；其二，处理的是异质成本实验池，而不是默认每个点等价；其三，显式建模多解分歧，而不是只依赖单个最优解附近的局部曲率。文章把这套方法放在一个统一 benchmark 上，与随机、均匀/网格、经典最优设计等策略比较，重点看预算受限下的外推误差。","experiments":"实验部分的重点不是单一任务刷分，而是验证这套选点策略在多种 scaling-law 场景下是否稳定有效。论文构建了一个较系统的 benchmark，覆盖不同 scaling 设定、不同 law family、以及不同成本结构。摘要和引言里明确提到的一个代表性任务是 Step Law，也就是学习率与 batch size 的缩放律；在这个任务上，方法在仅用 1% 预算时就进入低损失区域，接近外推 ground-truth optimum。这个结果说明，很多传统上靠大面积铺点才能看清的趋势，其实可以通过主动选点更快锁定。\n\n从全文叙述看，评测指标不是训练区拟合误差，而是 held-out target region 上的 extrapolation 任务上都观察到稳定优于经典设计策略的结果，并且在代表性的 Step Law 上，用原始拟合 FLOPs 的 1% 就能逼近最优外推区域。这已经足以说明方法不是只在单一 law family 上偶然成立。","reading_guide":"精读时先抓三件事。\n\n第一，看问题定义和目标函数。重点读 Problem Setup 和方法开头，确认作者到底优化的是什么：不是参数恢复误差，不是 控制。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper tackles a central but under-specified decision in diffusion language models: token ordering. In autoregressive models, the generation order is hard-coded as left-to-right, so the issue is hidden by the factorization itself. In DLMs, however, the model must decide which tokens to reveal first and which to defer. Existing choices are mostly random masking/reveal or confidence-driven progressive ordering. Random ordering creates train-test mismatch and ignores state information; confidence-based ordering is cheap but myopic, because it tends to lock in locally certain tokens even when that hurts globally better trajectories. The paper asks whether one can improve ordering without changing the host architecture, denoising objective, supervision, or data pipeline. DPRM is proposed as exactly such a plug-in controller.","importance":"Its importance is less about introducing a new base model and more about identifying token ordering as a first-class optimization axis in non-AR language modeling. That matters for pretraining research because it separates model capacity from generation control: a diffusion LM may already contain the right knowledge, yet fail to realize it under a poor reveal policy. The second important point is the interface design. DPRM modifies only the ordering policy, leaving the host model untouched. This makes it experimentally clean and practically useful: one can test ordering hypotheses on top of existing DLM systems without retraining the backbone. novel","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-04-27T03:48:21+00:00","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2604_24013.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.CV","cs.DC"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作解决的是分布式 的典型问题是最后一块通信无法被计算覆盖；块切得更细又会让算子算强度下降、内存和调度开销上升。文章要做的是在不引入过多同步和额外通信量的前提下，把这段尾部延迟尽量消掉，并把方案统一到训练和推理、多种并行范式上。","importance":"对预训练研究的价值主要在系统效率层面。很多 scaling 讨论默认算力足够、网络不是瓶颈，但真实大模型训练里，尤其是 TP/TPSP 跨卡甚至跨节点时，collective 通信常常决定 MFU 上限。FlashOverlap 的意义不在于提出新的并行维度，而是试图把已有并行策略的通信尾巴压到更小，让 TP、TPSP、UP、DP 这些常见配置更接近“通信被算子吃掉”的理想状态。如果结果扎实，这类工作会直接影响大模型训练的 sweet spot：哪些层适合做更细粒度并行、TP 是否能更自然地跨节点、以及长序列/大 hidden overlap 的调度空间更大。文章强调这是 exact algorithm，不是近似通信，也不是通过增加冗余计算来换延迟。\n\n第二步是 rank-adaptive partial output scheduling。这里是文章最值得看的点。作者观察到，并不是所有输出位置或输出分块都同样依赖远端通信。有些局部结果必须等通信回来，有些则可以先算。现有 chunk-based overlap 往往按固定顺序处理，导致最后一段 unavoidable tail。FlashOverlap 则根据 rank 和数据分布，优先计算那些“通信一到就能立刻接上”的部分，把不依赖通信或依赖较弱的部分后置，从而尽量把尾部压缩到最小。\n\n第三步是统一到多种并行模式。文中声称该框架不仅适用于 DP 中的 reduce-scatter，也适用于 TPSP 的 RS/AG，以及 Ulysses 相比，差异在于：后者主要通过切分张量并把通信塞到计算缝隙里，但尾块仍然暴露；FlashOverlap 试图从 collective 结构和计算顺序两端一起改，目标是把“最后一块没法藏”这个结构性问题消掉，而不是只调 chunk size 找折中。","experiments":"从引言和方法描述看，实验覆盖多种加速器、多种模型架构和多种并行策略，评价指标以 MFU、训练/推理延迟、以及每 token 时间为主。作者声称方法在 Transformer、Mamba、Hybrid 模型上都能稳定提升 MFU，并降低 latency；同时它让原本受限于单节点的 TP/TPSP 更有机会跨节点扩展。\n\n当前给到的正文片段没有完整实验表，因此不能安全写出具体百分比提升、节点规模、hidden size、batch size 等数字。但可以明确几类关键验证：\n1. 与主流 If a model is trained or fine-tuned to tolerate cross-layer K/V reuse, it no longer needs to depend rigidly on each layer’s private cache. That is different from post-hoc cache compression or token eviction, where the model was not trained for the failure mode. The work suggests that cache-efficient models can be obtained not only through MQA or GQA-style architectural changes, but also through training-time stochastic routing that encourages layerwise representational compatibility.","technical_approach":"The proposed method is Random Cross-Layer Attention, or R-CLA. During training, for layer l, the model uses its own K/V states with probability p, matching standard self-attention. With probability 1-p, it randomly selects a preceding layer l' < l and forces layer l to attend using that earlier layer’s K/V states. This simulates structural cache faults along the depth dimension. The layer learns to extract useful information from representations produced at different depths instead of relying only on its own feature space. At inference time, the model can cache only a subset of layers, such as every fourth layer, and have intermediate layers reuse the nearest or selected cached K/V states. This is orthogonal to temporal eviction: it preserves the full token history while reducing how many layer-specific K/V copies are stored per token.","experiments":"The reported findings focus on the quality-memory trade-off under different cache retention ratios. Most existing methods apply ","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-04-27T16:15:37+00:00","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2604_24647.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL","cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作解决的是长上下文推理中的 decoder-only transformer 和长度为 N 的输入，每层都会产生 N 个 token 的 key/value 表示，完整缓存的内存是 O(LNd)。传统 post-training KV pruning 通常对所有层使用相同保留比例，等价于令每层预算 B^(l) 相同。DepthKV 放弃这个假设，允许不同层有不同预算 B^(l)，只要求总预算受全局约束。\n\n作者先做 protection：对特定层段做保护，例如优先保留中间层更多 KV；\n2）metric-guided allocation：根据某种层重要性分数给高分层分配更多预算；\n3）hybrid strategy：把位置先验和度量引导结合起来。\n\n剪枝本身发生在 prefill 阶段，token 重要性由全序列注意力权重估计。也就是说，DepthKV 并不是重新设计注意力结构，也不需要重新训练模型，而是在已有 KV pruning 管线之上增加一层“预算如何跨层分配”的优化。它兼容已有 token-level 选择规则，创新点是把 layer budget 当成一等公民。\n\n全文还提出了一个有意思的分析概念：content amplification layers。作者观察到，某些对剪枝最敏感的层一旦被强剪，模型会生成更短、信息量更低的输出。这说明这些层的作用不只是局部注意力聚合，而可能与维持内容展开、信息延续有关。这个现象让 DepthKV 不只是工程技巧，也带一点机制分析意味。","experiments":"可见全文片段没有给出完整结果表，因此不能编造具体分数，但实验设计和主要结论已经比较清楚。\n\n1）任务设置：作者评测 document summarization、question answering、mathematical reasoning 等长上下文任务，并强调这些任务通常“输入远长于输出”，因此 prefill 才是主要计算和内存瓶颈。这个设定合理，因为 prefill 剪枝的收益在这类场景最直接。\n\n2）层重要性分析：通过单层剪枝消融，作者发现不同层对性能下降的影响差异显著。随后 在各类长上下文任务和不同模型上都稳定优于 uniform pruning。这里最值得关注的不是单点最优，而是“同预算下持续更好”这一趋势，因为它说明收益来自预算分配原则，而不是某个特定任务的偶然性。\n\n精读时建议补齐以下数字：测试模型名称与规模、上下文长度、预算压缩比、与哪些 pruning baseline 比较、不同 allocation strategy 的差异、以及在极低预算区间是否仍然保持优势。这些细节决定方法的实用边界。","reading_guide":"建议按“证据链”来读。先看 layer-wise ablation 和 permutation test，对应作者为什么有资格否定 uniform pruning 假设。没有这部分，DepthKV This work revisits the claim by isolating unstructured pruning, which preserves the architecture and only zeros individual weights, and studies whether TTS gains survive under sparsity and how layer-wise sparsity allocation changes the outcome.","importance":"This is not a new pretraining paradigm, but it matters for how people reason about capacity, redundancy, and long-horizon inference. The authors call this Context Unrolling: instead of mapping inputs directly to outputs, the model first expands a shared workspace with intermediate textual reasoning, visual tokens, depth, camera pose, view synthesis results, or hidden representations, and then conditions later predictions on that expanded context. multimodal、端到端跨模态 tokenization 都有直接启发。第三，这篇工作不是只报一个最终分数，而是设计了 Tuna-R 作为中间对照组，把“去掉 VAE”和“进一步去掉 representation encoder”分开分析，因此结论更有解释力。对做基座预训练的人来说，价值不只是模型结果，而是它揭示了一个趋势：预训练视觉编码器带来的先验并不总是净收益，尤其当目标是统一理解与生成、并且希望保留像素级细节时。","technical_approach":"方法上有两个关键层次。第一层是架构递进。作者先构造 Tuna-R：去掉 VAE，但保留预训练 representation encoder，把图像编码成视觉 token 后送入 LLM decoder；生成侧不再在 latent space 做扩散，而是在 pixel space 上做 flow matching，并采用 x-prediction 目标。这个版本的作用不是最终方案，而是作为受控基线，用来隔离“是否需要 encoder”这个变量。第二层是 Tuna-2：进一步移除视觉 encoder，只用简单 patch embedding 把图像或视频切成 patch token，再和文本 token 一起交给单个 transformer decoder 统一处理。理解和生成都在同一套 token 流和同一主干里完成，真正做到从 raw pixels 到文本/图像输出的端到端建模。\n\n真正让这个方案能训稳的是作者加入的 masking-based visual feature learning。因为像素空间直接建模比 latent space 更难，模型容易学到局部低层统计而不是稳健视觉语义。文中引入基于 mask 的视觉特征学习机制，用遮挡后的视觉输入迫使模型恢复或建模更有语义性的视觉结构，从而稳定训练并提升表示质量。这个设计可以理解为把 masked visual modeling 的归纳偏置注入到 unified pixel-space pretraining 里，缓解纯像素 flow/generative objective 对理解能力不友好的问题。\n\n从范式上看，Tuna-2 和很多“先有强视觉 encoder，再接 LLM”的 VLM 路线不同。它更接近 monolithic decoder-only multimodal model：视觉前端不再承担大部分感知工作，而是把感知能力也交给统一主干在预训练中自己长出来。与依赖 VAE latent 的生成模型相比，它避免了 latent tokenizer 带来的信息瓶颈和理解/生成目标不一致；与 decoupled encoder 方案相比，它减少了模块边界和预训练目标错配；与共享 encoder 的 unified representation 方案相比，它进一步去掉了外部视觉先验，换来更强的端到端可优化性。","experiments":"全文最有价值的实验不是单个 benchmark 的高分，而是 Tuna-R 与 Tuna-2 的受控比较。作者的核心结论是：在预训练不足时，encoder-based 的 Tuna-R 往往更容易起步，因为预训练视觉 encoder 提供了现成的视觉表征；但随着视觉-语言联合预训练继续推进，Tuna-2 在生成侧逐步追平甚至接近 Tuna-R，在理解侧则持续超过 Tuna-R，优势在细粒度、感知密集型任务上更明显。这说明 encoder-free 方案前期更难训，但上限并不低，而且理解收益更清楚。\n\n论文声称在多项多模态理解与生成 benchmark 上取得了当时最强的一档结果，重点不是单一任务，而是同一模型同时覆盖 understanding 和 generation。理解侧，作者特别强调细粒度视觉感知、局部细节识别、复杂视觉问答等任务上的提升；生成侧，pixel-space flow matching 没有因为去掉 VAE 而明显掉队，说明直接像素建模在统一框架下是可扩展的。文中还做了较系统的消融，围绕几个问题展开：是否保留 representation encoder、masking-based feature learning 是否必要、不同预训练阶段两种架构的收敛动态如何、encoder-free 方案在何时从劣势转为优势。这些消融比最终榜单更值得看，因为它们直接回答了“为什么能行”。\n\n给定当前提供的全文片段，没有看到完整表格中的参数量、训练 token 数、图像/视频数据规模和各 benchmark 的逐项数字，因此不适合编造具体数值。可以确认的是，作者把 Tuna-R 作为中间模型进行 controlled comparison，并且明确报告了：充分预训练后，Tuna-2 在 generation 上与 Tuna-R 竞争，在 understanding 上稳定更优。","reading_guide":"建议按“问题设定—中间基线—最终方案—训练稳定性—受控比较”这条线读。\n\n第一遍先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2。重点不是记结论，而是弄清作者到底拆掉了哪些模块：先去掉 VAE，再去掉 representation encoder，最后只剩 unified multimodal modeling: do we still need pretrained vision encoders if we want one model to handle both visual understanding and visual generation? Prior unified models usually follow one of two designs. Either they use separate visual representations—CLIP-like encoders for understanding and VAE/VQ-style latents for generation—which creates a representation mismatch, or they move to a shared visual representation but still depend on a pretrained vision encoder. Tuna-2 pushes one step further and asks whether those encoders can be removed entirely, leaving only patch embeddings plus a single decoder trained end-to-end from raw pixels. retrieval 的一致提升。对做 pretrain 的人，真正有启发的是数据清洗、时序切分、候选生成、推理式精修这条链路，而不是单点模型性能。","technical_approach":"方法分三段。第一段是视频过滤与分段。作者从 HowTo100M 中筛 instructional videos，并把长视频切成视觉上相对一致的 shots。这里的目的不是传统镜头检测本身，而是给后续步骤生成提供更稳定的局部上下文，避免一个 prompt 同时覆盖多个动作。与此同时，还会过滤视觉-文本明显失配的内容，减少后续大模型在坏样本上“硬解释”。第二段是候选步骤生成。作者使用 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 联合看视频帧和对应 transcript，为每个 shot 生成候选 procedural step。这里关键不是简单 caption，而是要求输出结构化、可执行、与片段绑定的步骤描述，因此它更接近 procedural abstraction：把口语化 narration 和视觉动作压缩成规范步骤。第三段是步骤精修与合并。作者用 DeepSeek-R1 对候选步骤做两类处理：一类是语义清洗，把含糊指代、口语冗余、碎片化表达改写成更清晰的 instruction-like step；另一类是时间修正与跨 shot 合并，把被切碎的同一动作合并，或把错位的描述重新对齐到更合理的时间段。这个设计体现了明确分工：Qwen2.5-VL 负责感知与局部 grounding，DeepSeek-R1 负责长上下文推理、重写和全局一致性整理。相比早期直接用单个 AR 模型从 transcript 生成步骤，这里更强调“先局部感知，再全局整理”，原因是长视频中的误差主要来自局部视觉遗漏和全局时间错配，两者需要不同能力的模型处理。论文还构建了 DenseCaption100 作为 100 个视频的人写 dense annotation benchmark，用来验证自动流水线的质量，而不是只看下游任务分数。","experiments":"数据侧，最终得到 DenseStep2M：约 100K 不是只会生成流畅文本，而是真能提供可训练的时序 supervision。应用侧，作者把 DenseStep2M 用于微调 vision-language models，在生成式任务上提升 dense captioning 和 procedural grounding，在判别式任务上提升 cross-modal retrieval。这里最值得注意的不是某一个 benchmark Raw instructional corpora such as HowTo100M are attractive because they contain rich procedural demonstrations, but they are hard to use directly. Standard flow matching already exhibits some low-to-high frequency ordering because low-frequency modes are easier to fit under high noise, but that ordering is weak, entangled, and not directly controllable. Existing solutions split into two camps. K-Flow enforces frequency order by redefining flow time along a frequency scale, which gives a hard constraint but changes the state space and interpolation path. That is a useful pattern for pretraining research more broadly. If one wants structure-before-detail behavior, the bias does not necessarily need to be baked into the main objective or state space; it can be injected through auxiliary representations and asynchronous training dynamics. This can inform data design for multimodal continual training, unified understanding-generation models, and process supervision for generative models.","technical_approach":"Meta-CoT has two decomposition levels. For instance, a quantity edit requires identifying the target, localizing it, and counting. The resulting CoT contains a task summary, task reasoning, and target-wise editing traversal. The second level is meta-task decomposition: complex edit tasks are mapped to a small set of primitive operations such as add, remove, and replace, so the model can compose them to cover broader edit types. The training mixture also includes visual understanding tasks to cover the required abilities in the triplet. A key ablation shows that training on a small number of meta-tasks, as few as five, can generalize to other edit types with performance close to training on the full task set. summation，作为 joint token 输入 backbone。backbone 按时间自回归地预测下一个 joint patch hidden state，条件包括文本前缀和历史上下文。随后，音频 head 和视频 head 各自从这个 hidden state 出发，用独立 diffusion 过程解码出对应模态的 frame-level latent。\n\n这个设计和 text-to-audio-video、audio-to-video talking head、video-to-audio dubbing 三种模式。这一点更像统一条件接口设计，而不是为每个任务单独做一套模型。","experiments":"从给出的全文片段看，作者声称在 talking head benchmarks 上，相比 dual-branch diffusion 把这类二元偏好当成单一、干净、可传递的监督信号来学，会把互相矛盾的梯度混在一起，结果是随着数据增加，模型并没有学到更清晰的偏好边界。作者进一步指出，问题不只在算法，也在数据：旧数据集分辨率低、prompt noise、合成偏好冲突是同一类问题。第二层是数据工程上的：作者用实验把“高质量偏好数据比复杂算法更关键”这件事讲得比较清楚。Poly-DPO 在脏数据上有用，但在高质量 ViPO-Image-1M 上会自然退化回标准 DPO，说明当数据足够干净时，额外鲁棒项不再重要。这个结论对 RLHF / DPO / RLAIF 乃至 post-train 数据构造都有参考价值。就 LLM 基座研究而言，它不是直接的文本预训练论文，但对‘偏好学习如何随数据规模扩展’这个问题有实质信息增益。","technical_approach":"技术上有两部分。第一部分是 Poly-DPO。它建立在 Diffusion-DPO 之上，在原有偏好目标外加入一个多项式项，用来按样本置信度动态调节训练权重。直观上，标准 DPO 会对“模型已经很确定”或“标签本身带冲突”的样本继续施加强梯度，容易造成过置信和错误放大；Poly-DPO 通过一个由超参数 α 控制的多项式修正，让不同置信区间的样本贡献不同。作者强调它同时处理两类问题：一类是冲突偏好样本，此时需要降低错误监督对更新方向的破坏；另一类是过于简单的样本，此时需要抑制模型在 trivially separable pair 上继续变得更极端。这个设计和分类里的 focal-style reweighting 有相似精神，但这里不是按类别不平衡，而是按偏好学习中的置信度与数据噪声结构来调节。第二部分是 ViPO 数据集。作者没有沿用已有开源偏好集，而是重新构建了大规模高分辨率视觉偏好数据：图像部分 100 万对、1024px，覆盖五类；视频部分 30 万对、720p+，覆盖三类。数据由较新的生成模型产生，包括 FLUX、Qwen-Image、WanVideo，并通过系统化类别设计与平衡采样来减少分布偏斜。论文的一个关键论点是，算法鲁棒性和数据质量不是替代关系，而是互补关系：脏数据需要 Poly-DPO，干净数据则让标准 DPO 已经足够。","experiments":"实验重点不是单点榜单，而是几个趋势。第一，在噪声较重的 Pick-a-Pic V2 上，Poly-DPO 明显优于标准 Diffusion-DPO，说明它确实能从冲突偏好中提取更稳定的学习信号。摘要和引言没有给出完整表格数字，但全文结论很明确：标准 DPO 随数据规模扩展会出现收益饱和，而 Poly-DPO 能延缓这种饱和。第二，在作者构建的 ViPO 数据上，数据质量带来的收益比旧数据集更显著。用 ViPO 训练时，SD1.5 的结果显著超过基于现有偏好数据训练的版本；对 SD3.5-Medium targets a scaling failure in visual preference optimization rather than proposing yet another preference objective in isolation. The central question is: why do off-policy methods such as Diffusion-DPO stop improving when preference data scale increases? The answer developed in the full text is that existing open visual preference datasets contain many conflicting pairwise labels. The preferred image may be better on one axis, such as aesthetics, but worse on another, such as prompt faithfulness or structural correctness. Standard DPO treats these pairs as clean scalar preference supervision, so contradictory gradients accumulate and scaling saturates. The authors also argue that the bottleneck is partly data-side: older datasets are low-resolution, narrow in prompt coverage, distributionally imbalanced, and generated by outdated image models, which makes the preference signal itself unstable.","importance":"For pretraining-oriented readers, the value is less about diffusion image alignment per se and more about a general lesson for scalable preference learning. The paper makes a concrete case that scaling failures often come from supervision quality, not only from the objective. That maps well to LLM post-training settings with noisy preference labels, reward inconsistency, and synthetic preference conflicts. A second useful point is the separation between algorithmic robustness and data quality. Poly-DPO helps on noisy datasets, but on the cleaner ViPO-Image-1M benchmark it collapses back to standard DPO with the best alpha near zero. That is a meaningful result: once the data are sufficiently clean, extra robustness machinery becomes unnecessary. steps，计算代价又很高，且不一定把额外算力用在真正需要推敲的局部结构上。","importance":"对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性不算强，因为主体仍是文生图扩散模型，而不是语言模型预训练范式本身。但它有两个可借鉴点。第一，它把“latent reasoning / recursive computation”从文本域迁到连续视觉 latent，并且不是简单加深网络，而是在条件对齐最关键的模块里做稀疏递归，这对研究非 AR 建模、diffusion LM、以及 test-time / train-time adaptive compute 有参考意义。第二，它把 MoE 路由、Gumbel-Softmax 稀疏选择、adapter 化轻量递归三者结合，展示了一种在大 backbone 上插入可控额外计算的方式。贡献量级更像方法探索而不是范式改写，适合把它当成“连续 latent 上如何做稀疏递归推理”的案例来读。","technical_approach":"方法核心是把一个递归稀疏模块插入到 diffusion transformer，尤其是 SD3 这类 MMDiT block 的 joint attention 部分。作者的判断是：joint attention 负责文本-视觉结构对齐，若要提升复杂 prompt 的遵循能力，最值得加计算的地方不是所有层平均加深，而是这些负责跨模态结构建模的层。\n\n具体做法分三层。第一层是 recursive sparse reasoning。给定当前视觉 token、扩散 timestep、以及条件信息（类别标签或文本 embedding），模型在一个 block 内执行多个 latent recursion steps。每一步并不启用完整新子网络，而是从一组共享 neural modules 中稀疏选出少量模块，对视觉 token 做迭代细化。这样做的目的，是让不同递归步或不同 token 区域可以调用不同“功能模块”，形成某种分工，而不是所有样本都走同一条固定计算路径。\n\n第二层是 sparse routing 与可学习专家分化。作者没有用普通 soft mixture，而是引入 Gumbel-Softmax 近似离散选择，并采用 winner-takes-all 式梯度分配，让被选中的模块得到更明确的训练信号。这样做是为了避免软路由下所有模块都学成平均化残差修正器，难以形成真正 specialization。路由条件不仅看视觉 token，还看 diffusion timestep 和文本条件，这意味着专家选择既依赖当前图像状态，也依赖生成阶段和语义约束。\n\n第三层是 mixture-of-adapters 与 recursive adapter updates。作者没有为每个递归步复制完整 attention/MLP，而是用 adapter 形式承载递归更新，并在多步递归中累积这些 adapter 输出。这样把额外参数和计算压到较低水平，适合在已有 DiT/SD3 上做微调式改造，而不是从头训练一个大得多的模型。\n\n从设计取舍看，这套方法和“直接增加 denoising steps”不同，后者把更多计算平均分配到整个采样轨迹；这里则是在单步内部、在跨模态对齐关键层、按条件稀疏分配计算。它也不同于标准 MoE FFN，因为这里的专家调用带有递归时间维度，目标不是单层容量扩展，而是多次内部状态修正。","experiments":"全文给出的实验主要分三块。第一块是 class-conditioned ImageNet generation，在 DiT 设置下用 FID、sFID、IS、precision、recall 评估。作者声称递归稀疏模块在相近或更低额外计算下优于常规基线，说明收益不只是来自参数增加，而是来自把计算放在更合适的位置。第二块是 text-to-image，对 SD3 类模型在 GenEval 上评估文本-图像对齐，重点看复杂 prompt 的遵循。文中还提到 DPG 等文本跟随评测，结论是递归细化能改善结构布局和语义一致性。第三块是分析实验，包括 token trajectory visualization，用来展示不同模块在递归过程中出现功能分化，这部分是理解方法是否真的学到 specialization 的关键证据。\n\n不过，从给出的全文片段看，具体数字、参数规模、递归步数、专家数、训练 token / 图像规模等细节没有完整展开，至少当前材料里无法可靠复述精确提升幅度。能确认的是：作者先在较简单的 class-conditioned DiT 上验证，再扩展到更复杂的 SD3；并且强调 sparse activation of lightweight shared modules 带来更好的计算-效果折中。若要判断方法是否扎实，必须去看主表里相对基线的绝对提升是否稳定，以及消融里“递归本身”“稀疏路由”“Gumbel winner-take-all”“adapter 累积”各自贡献多少。","reading_guide":"这篇更适合泛读，不建议投入精读级时间。优先看三处。第一，看方法图和 joint attention 改造公式，确认递归到底发生在 block Attention Sink。训练上先用合成的 interleaving 数据做 SFT，再做 HPO 后训练。\n\nHPO 的主体是对 GRPO 的改造。对每个长语音片段，策略采样多个候选翻译轨迹，分别计算质量奖励和时延奖励。关键不在“用了 GRPO”，而在 reward 结构：\n1. 质量奖励和时延奖励分开计算，而不是先线性合并。\n2. 设一个质量阈值；如果某条轨迹的质量没过线，则其 latency reward 直接打到最小值。这样模型不能靠提前输出换取总 reward。\n3. 对质量和时延 reward 分别做 group normalization，再合并成最终优势信号，减少某一项 reward 方差或尺度主导训练。\n\n这个设计针对的是 SST 的结构性难点。时延目标天然单调，容易学成“尽早说”；质量目标则稀疏、延迟、且受整句一致性影响。层级 reward 相当于把优化从“软权衡”改成“带门控的偏好约束”。从全文表述看，作者还强调这是在有噪轨迹监督上的纠偏，而不是从零学 read/write policy，因此它依赖一个还算可用的 SFT 初始化。论文也说明了训练样本构造：从分钟到小时级长录音中切出最长 67.2 秒的片段，每段 60 个 chunk、每个 chunk 1.12 秒；先用 ASR 时间戳对齐语音和转写，再用 SimAlign 做 Recent SST systems reformulate the task as an interleaved dialogue so they can fully reuse KV cache across speech and text, which is attractive for long-context streaming inference. The problem is that the supervision used to train those read/write behaviors is imperfect. Alignment-based synthesis ignores future context needed for proper timing, while LLM-based segmentation does not guarantee valid trajectories. As a result, the model learns brittle waiting and premature-writing behaviors. ambiguity region，正确率波动大，是伪奖励噪声的主要来源。因此他们不再像原始 TTRL 那样把所有 rollout 一视同仁，而是基于频次筛掉中频、保留更可靠的高频正样本和低频负样本，同时维持正负样本平衡。这里的关键不是简单“只保留高置信样本”，因为 RL 还需要有区分度的正负对比；所以作者强调 balanced sampling，而不是纯过滤。\n\n第二步是 debiased advantage estimation。原始 TTRL 使用 GRPO，在每个 group 内对 reward 做相对归一化。问题在于，当伪标签本身有噪声、而 group 共识又不高时，这种相对归一化会把少量错误奖励放大成更大的 advantage，导致模型朝错误方向更新。作者给出理论分析说明这种偏差在低共识区更严重。为此，DDRL 用固定的、标签依赖的 advantage 取代 group-relative normalization，目标是消除由组内统计量引入的额外偏差。直观上，这相当于承认“奖励已经不干净”，因此不再让组内均值和方差进一步扭曲它。\n\n第三步是 consensus-based off-policy refinement。RL 阶段结束后，作者再构造一个基于共识的 rejection sampling 数据集，做轻量的离策略精修。这个阶段更像把 RL 过程中积累的较高置信样本转成稳定的监督信号，用更低方差的方式巩固收益。为什么不一开始就只做 rejection sampling？因为 TTRL 的目标是 test-time 适配，先用 RL 在当前测试分布上推动策略移动，再用离策略 refinement 稳定收尾，兼顾了适应性和稳定性。","experiments":"摘要给出的主结果是：相对原始 TTRL，DDRL 在 In TTRL, the model samples multiple answers, derives a pseudo-label by majority vote, and then updates itself using that pseudo-label as reward supervision. Many existing methods rely on a fixed divergence regime. SPIN is closely related to a KL-based regime, SPACE to a Jensen-Shannon-style objective via noise contrastive estimation, and SPIF to $χ^2$-regularized self-play. Since these divergences exhibit different strengths depending on the distributional gap b","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-04-22T11:52:21+00:00","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2604_20933.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是 self-play fine-tuning 里一个很具体但长期存在的问题：训练目标所对应的散度一旦固定，往往只在某个训练阶段合适，跨阶段就会失配。SPIN 一类 KL 风格目标在模型和目标分布差距较大时梯度平滑、容易推进，但到后期真实样本与自生成样本逐渐接近时，reward gap 会塌成常数，学习信号变弱；JS/NCE 风格方法更稳，但后期分辨细小差异的能力不足；χ² 正则方法能约束 reward 爆炸、在近收敛区更敏感，但早期对离群样本过于苛刻。论文要解决的不是再修一个局部 failure mode，而是给 self-play 提供一个可连续调节的统一目标，使训练压力能随阶段变化而变化，而不是被单一散度绑死。","importance":"对预训练/后训练接口的意义主要有两层。第一，它把一批看起来分散的 self-play 方法放进同一个 f-divergence / Rényi divergence 框架里，给出了更清楚的目标函数视角。这种统一视角对做 post-train 的人很有用，因为很多训练稳定性问题并不是数据构造本身，而是目标函数在不同分布间距下的梯度形态不同。第二，它提出的可插值目标和双自由度控制，提供了一种比“换 loss 试试”更系统的调参方式。量级上，这不是改写基础预训练范式的工作，但对无额外偏好标注的数据自举、self-improvement、以及 SFT 之后如何继续榨取模型能力，是一类有方法论价值的工作。","technical_approach":"方法核心是用 Rényi divergence 取代固定 KL / JS / χ² 目标。Rényi 散度有一个连续参数 α，可以在 α→1 时退化到 KL，在 α=2 时对应 χ² 家族，在 α=1/2 附近与 Hellinger 距离相关。作者不是只停留在“理论上可统一”，而是利用其 variational representation 推出一个可训练的 self-play 目标，并把它写成对真实响应和模型生成响应的两个独立项。这个分解很关键，因为它继承了 NCE / binary classification 类目标在训练上的稳定性，避免了原始 SPIN 那种完全依赖 reward gap 的退化。\n\n更具体地看，IRIS 有两个独立控制维度。一个维度控制散度形状，也就是 α，决定训练更像 KL、还是更像 χ²/JS 一侧；另一个维度控制真实样本与合成样本项的相对权重或温度，从而分别调节“拉近真实分布”和“压低旧模型分布”的力度。论文强调这两个自由度是解耦的，因此可以单独分析：一个负责分布间距敏感性，一个负责正负样本学习动态。与 SPIN 相比，它不再依赖单一的差值式 reward；与 SPACE 相比，它不是固定在 JS/NCE 近邻；与 SPIF 相比，它不是只靠 χ² 约束 reward 上界，而是把这些 regime 作为连续谱上的不同点。\n\n从机制上，作者的论点是：训练早期模型和目标差距大，需要更宽容、梯度更平滑的散度；训练后期差距小，需要对细微偏差更敏感、同时 reward 不失控的散度。IRIS 允许在训练过程中固定一个中间 α，也允许做 schedule。全文看下来，真正的新意不只是“用 Rényi”，而是把 self-play reasoning+问题+prompt”时 verifier 的答案是否一致；如果加上问题后答案才稳定，说明 reasoning 本身不自洽或信息不充分。第二层是训练过程分析。作者在 Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B 上做 RLVR 轨迹分析，并补充 Llama3.2-3B 以验证家族外一致性；任务来自 ReasoningGym 的 40 个任务。第三层是干预实验。作者先验证一个假设：很多任务的 accuracy 提升并不依赖 reasoning，于是直接比较“带 reasoning 的 RLVR”和“无 reasoning 的 RLVR”；随后又测试两种改进路径：先用少量高质量 expert traces 做 supervised learning 再接 RLVR，以及在 RLVR 中显式加入 CIR/SR 奖励。和现有工作不同的地方在于，它不是把 reasoning 当作输出风格，而是把 reasoning 当作一个需要单独评估其因果地位和信息完备性的训练对象。","experiments":"关键结果有几组。第一，RLVR 虽然普遍提升任务准确率，但并不稳定提升 CIR 和 SR：在 ReasoningGym 的 40 个任务里，19 个任务的 CIR 下降，17 个任务的 SR 下降。也就是说，模型更会答题了，但 reasoning 可能更像伴随文本，而不是决策所依赖的中间变量。第二，只有那些在 RLVR 过程中 accuracy 提升超过 50 个点的任务，CIR 和 SR 才更可靠地同步上升；这说明当任务确实迫使模型借助显式 reasoning 才能解出来时，outcome reward 才更可能间接塑造出有用 reasoning。第三，作者做了“去 reasoning”对照：对于最终 CIR/SR 低的任务，不输出 reasoning 直接做 RLVR，accuracy 提升与带 reasoning 版本相近，支持了“这些任务的提分并不靠 reasoning”这一解释。第四，SL-before-RL 很有效：先用一小批高质量 reasoning traces 做监督微调，再做 RLVR，CIR 和 SR 会在 RLVR 期间继续上升，而不是像纯 RLVR 那样漂移。第五，显式加入 CIR/SR 奖励后，可以在不依赖 expert traces 的情况下，同时改善 CIR/SR 并基本保持最终 accuracy。摘要里没有给出所有绝对数值，但从全文叙述看，作者更关心的是任务级分布、训练过程趋势和对照实验的一致性，而不是单一平均分。","reading_guide":"建议先看指标定义和它们背后的条件独立解释，也就是 CIR/SR 为什么分别对应“模型是否用到了 reasoning”和“reasoning 是否足够让别人复核”。这部分决定了整篇工作的可信度。然后重点看三组实验：一是 40 个任务上 accuracy 与 CIR/SR 的关系，二是 with/without reasoning 的 RLVR 对照，三是 SL-before-RL 与 joint reward 的改进结果。读图时不要只盯平均值，更要看任务间异质性：哪些任务 accuracy 上升但 CIR/SR 不升，哪些任务三者一起升，这决定了作者的核心结论。值得深挖的点有两个：其一，CIR 依赖“截断 reasoning 后强制提前作答”的操作，这个测量会不会混入 exposure bias 或 decoding artifact；其二，SR 依赖 verifier 模型，因而会受 verifier 能力和 prompt 设计影响。若要把这套方法迁移到更大模型或开放域推理，这两点都需要重新校准。精读时间建议 45–60 分钟，若只抓主线，先读 Introduction、指标定义、Section 5–7 和主要图表即可。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper asks a sharper question than whether RLVR improves accuracy. When chain-of-thought is trained with outcome-only verifiable rewards, do the emitted reasoning traces actually play a causal role in producing the answer, and are they self-contained enough for an external verifier to recover the answer from the trace alone? The authors formalize these as two separate properties: Causal Importance of Reasoning (CIR), which measures how much the model’s answer distribution depends on the reasoning tokens, and Sufficiency of Reasoning (SR), which measures whether the reasoning itself is informative enough to determine the answer without relying on the original question. The central result is that RLVR often optimizes correctness without reliably optimizing either property.","importance":"This matters because a large part of current reasoning post-training implicitly treats “better outcome reward + longer CoT” as evidence of more faithful reasoning. Verification quality increasingly determines RL rewards, rejection sampling, reranking, self-correction, and data filtering. Executable verifiers are more controllable and reproducible than LLM judges, while automatic induction reduces the cost and narrowness of hand-written rules. The main idea is to let an LLM propose candidate programs but let execution results and labeled examples select and compress them. This is a practical alternative to relying only on neural reward models or manually engineered checks.","technical_approach":"AutoPyVerifier treats verifier construction as search over sets of Python functions. Each example contains a task input x, a model output y, a target label l, and optional extracted values z from the output. A verifier is an executable function that checks whether a property holds, and a verifier set predicts the target through joint satisfaction. The system first asks an LLM to synthesize initial verifier sets and inserts them as nodes in a DAG. It then iteratively expands selected nodes by adding new functions or revising existing ones. Node selection combines predictive quality, such as F1 against labels, exploration value, verifier-set size, and feasibility. The design avoids using the LLM as the final judge; instead, the LLM defines a search space and the labeled development set constrains which programs survive.","experiments":"The evaluation covers coding, mathematical reasoning, function calling, and instruction following, using outputs from several LLMs. AutoPyVerifier improves over the initial LLM-generated verifier sets, with gains up to 55.0 F1 points. Transfer experiments show that many verifiers work on outputs from a different base model, suggesting that they capture reusable task-level checks rather than only model-specific artifacts. When exposed back to an LLM as external inference-time tools, the discovered verifier sets improve downstream accuracy by up to 17.0 percentage points. Ablations indicate that exploration, compactness, and feasibility terms matter differently across benchmarks and models, and that search tends to move verifiers from shallow format checks toward more structural and semantic checks.","reading_guide":"Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-04-03T11:30:56+00:00","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2604_22779.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.AI","cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"在“可回答就回答、不可回答就拒答”的开放域事实问答里，用 Pθ^(1-q)) / (1-q)。q=0 时得到 ℓ0 = 1 - Pθ，对应 exact-match reward 下的 RLVR 或 expected accuracy 最大化；q=1 时得到 ℓ1 = -log Pθ，对应对 latent trajectories 的 log-marginal-likelihood。核心性质是所有 q 的每样本梯度方向相同，只差一个标量放大：∇θℓq = Pθ^(-q) ∇θℓ0 = Pθ^(1-q) ∇θℓ1。q 越大，低 Pθ 样本被放大越强，模型越快贴近监督；q 越小，损失越有界，对错误标签更不敏感。这个 per-instance amplification 不能用一个全局 learning rate 等价替代，因为 learning rate 对所有样本同乘一个系数，而 q 改变的是样本间相对权重。实践上，Pθ 不可精确计算，因此作者给出两类 Monte Carlo 梯度估计。RL factorization 使用 M 条采样 rationales，并通过 Rao-Blackwellized reward pθ(y* | x*, z) 降低方差；它统计效率高，但会混入与正确答案语义不一致的轨迹贡献。FT factorization 近似从“能导向正确答案的轨迹后验”中采样，再对这些轨迹做常规 fine-tuning；它的梯度更语义一致，但采样效率和覆盖度更受限制。两者在框架内具有相同偏差，适合不同训练阶段。","experiments":"论文给出的关键定量结论主要围绕训练动态。理论上，exploitation pole q=0 的冷启动逃逸时间为 Ω(1 / p0)，当初始成功概率很低时会很慢；density-estimation pole q=1 的逃逸时间为 Θ(log(1 / p0))，因此能更快从低成功率样本中获得训练信号。噪声方面，q=0 的有界损失和 escort tempering 会削弱错误标签影响，而 q=1 会更强地拟合训练分布，也包括错误标注。中间 q 提供冷启动速度和噪声鲁棒性的折中。实验设计的重点应是 q sweep、不同初始 p0、不同标签噪声率、以及两类 Monte Carlo estimator 的比较。提供的全文内容没有给出完整 benchmark 数字表，因此最可靠的数字是上述复杂度结论、q=0/1 两端点定义，以及 M 条 rationale 采样的估计形式。","reading_guide":"建议精读。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，明确 q 被解释为 commitment，而不是普通温度或学习率。然后看定义 Pθ 和 Tsallis loss 的部分，确认 latent trajectory 被边缘化后训练目标如何连接 RLVR 与 log-marginal-likelihood。Proposition 4.1 是核心，应仔细推导 ∇θℓq = Pθ^(-q)∇θℓ0 = Pθ^(1-q)∇θℓ1；这决定了论文的主要机制。Theorem 5.1 和 Theorem 5.2 解释冷启动速度差异，是判断 q 选择的关键。Appendix C 的噪声鲁棒性结果也应读，尤其是 bounded loss 和 escort tempering 如何过滤错误标签。最后看 Monte Carlo estimator 一节和 Figure 2，区分 RL factorization 与 FT factorization 在统计效率、语义一致性、以及训练阶段适配上的取舍。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper addresses a concrete optimization problem in post-training reasoning models. With only output-level supervision, RLVR can stall when the initial success probability p0 is small. student rollout 与 reference solution 的 overlap 自适应决定可见上下文量。直觉是：如果当前 rollout 和标准解偏得很远，teacher 需要更强纠偏，就暴露更多解题上下文；如果 rollout 已经比较接近，就少暴露一些，避免 teacher 目标退化成对某一条参考轨迹的硬匹配。这样做不是简单的数据增强，而是在 privileged branch 以 ECR 的概率跳到 Correct。于是准确率的递推式可以写成\nAcc(k+1)=Acc(k)(1-EIR(k))+(1-Acc(k))ECR(k)。\n\n由这个式子，作者推导出几个部署上真正有用的量。第一是 net benefit 为零的边界条件，也就是什么时候该停：当 correction gain 与 introduction loss 正好平衡时，再迭代就没有收益。进一步整理后得到文中的诊断不等式 ECR/EIR > Acc/(1-Acc)。这个判据的含义很直白：模型越准，右边阈值越高，因此要想靠自纠继续提升，就必须让 EIR 极低，否则少量“改坏”就会抵消大量“改对”。第二是稳态准确率 π* 和几何收敛性质。作者指出，当 EIR 和 ECR 都很低时，收敛会很慢；而对高准确率模型，如果 π* 低于 baseline self-confidence 和 batch-level 的 EIR/ECR 估计，决定是否继续 refinement。论文的一个重要判断是：当前容易做到的是 prompt-level 的 EIR suppression，它能防止退化；真正想获得稳定增益，可能需要 training-level 地提升 ECR，而这不是简单 prompt engineering Loss curves collapse training into a scalar, while full-matrix spectral trajectories expose layerwise structure that the loss cannot show. A useful distinction is made between stable-rank compression and spectral shape. Stable rank measures how much effective dimensionality has collapsed; the power-law exponent α measures what kind of spectrum has formed. This distinction matters for early-training monitoring, layer-importance estimation, pruning, and possibly failure diagnosis. For every weight matrix, the authors repeatedly compute a full SVD and track stable rank, weighted alpha, and spectral entropy. Stable rank is defined by the Frobenius norm divided by the squared top singular value. Weighted alpha is fitted on the leading 20% of singular values in log-log space. Spectral entropy provides an independent check on concentration. Compression onset is defined as the first step where stable rank falls below 90% of its initialization value, and onset time is regressed against layer index to estimate wave velocity. The key design choice is to analyze time, depth, and matrix type jointly, which reveals transient compression waves, persistent α gradients, and projection-specific asymmetry.","experiments":"$ca","reading_guide":"A 30–45 minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. For channel i, with activation u_i and down-projection column v_i, masking the channel induces an output perturbation -u_i v_i. Let g_y be the loss gradient at the FFN output, and define the projected gradient s_i = v_i^T g_y, equivalently the gradient backpropagated to that channel activation. The channel score is based on the joint second moment of activation and projected gradient, approximately E[(u_i s_i)^2]. This score measures loss sensitivity, not just magnitude. The top 1% of channels per layer by this proxy are called supernodes. Existing approaches either rely on fixed lemma libraries, which limit adaptability, or synthesize highly specific intermediate lemmas tailored to individual theorems, thereby lacking generality. DreamProver addresses this gap through an iterative two-stage process. In the wake stage, DreamProver attempts to prove theorems from a training ","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-04-29T05:35:02+00:00","category_id":"coding_agent","cover_url":"/covers/2604_26311.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作要解决的是 formal theorem proving 中一个长期存在但常被弱化的问题：系统会解题，但不会稳定积累“可迁移的中层知识”。现有方法要么依赖固定 lemma library，适应性差；要么在每道题里临时生成 problem-specific 的中间引理，虽然能帮助当前证明，却很难在后续题目中复用。DreamProver 的核心问题因此不是单题搜索，而是如何让 proving agent 在一组相关定理上迭代学习、抽象、压缩并沉淀出可复用的 lemma library，从而形成跨题目的能力增长。","importance":"它对基座预训练不是直接贡献，但对“LLM 如何通过交互式过程积累可迁移技能”有明确启发，属于 pretrain↔post-train 接口附近的工作。价值主要有三点。第一，它把 theorem proving 从单次推理问题改成了带外部记忆和知识压缩的持续学习问题。第二，它给出了一种比较具体的 wake-sleep 式 agent 学习框架：wake 阶段负责探索和产生候选知识，sleep 阶段负责抽象、去重、压缩和验证。第三，它说明在高结构化领域里，单纯增加采样和搜索并不如“学会沉淀 reusable abstractions”有效。对做 reasoning pretrain、tool-augmented learning、self-improving agent 的研究员，这个思路比单个 benchmark 提升更值得看。","technical_approach":"DreamProver 的方法围绕一个迭代的 wake–sleep 循环展开。\n\n在 wake stage，系统带着当前 lemma library 去证明训练集中的定理。这里有两个关键步骤。其一是 learnable theorem identification：系统在固定 proof attempt 和 error-correction budget 下，直接提示 LLM 使用当前库中的 lemmas 去证明目标定理。如果在预算内能证明，就把该定理视为当前知识水平下“可学习”的对象，因为它可能蕴含一个建立在现有知识之上的更高层 lemma。其二是 intermediate theorem discovery：对于不能直接证明的难题，系统递归地做 theorem decomposition，把大问题拆成更 tractable 的中间定理。这样得到的中间定理既是证明过程的副产物，也是后续 library 学习的原料。\n\n在 sleep stage，系统不直接把所有候选引理塞进库里，而是做结构化的 lemma evolution。根据引言和方法描述，这一阶段至少包含 clustering、pruning、abstraction、validation 几步：先按语义相似性聚类并去重，避免库无限膨胀；再对同一簇中的具体引理做抽象，生成更一般、更可迁移的高层 lemma；最后验证这些抽象后的 lemma 是否可被 formal system 接受，并用它们更新库。这里的关键取舍很清楚：如果只追求覆盖率，库会迅速变成一堆局部技巧；如果只追求抽象度，又可能生成过泛、不可证或无用的 lemma。DreamProver 试图在可证明性、紧凑性和复用性之间找平衡。\n\n推理时，测试集上的定理证明直接使用学到的 lemma library。也就是说，训练阶段学到的不是参数更新本身，而是一套可显式调用的、经过压缩的形式化知识单元。与很多依赖在线生成中间步骤的方法相比，这种设计更接近“外显技能库”。\n\n从方法差异看，它不同于固定库检索，也不同于每题临时合成中间引理。前者没有成长机制，后者没有沉淀机制。DreamProver 的新意在于把“发现—抽象—验证—复用”做成闭环。","experiments":"实验覆盖多个数学领域 benchmark，包括不等式、数论、组合、平面几何和机器学习理论。作者报告的主结果是：使用学到的 lemma library 后，相比先前方法 proving success rate 提升 61%；同时 proof length 降低 50%，token usage 降低 48%。这组结果说明收益不只是多解出一些题，还体现在证明更短、搜索更省。\n\n从全文可确认的实验重点，至少包括以下几类。第一，跨领域泛化：不是只在单一数学子域上有效，而是在多个 formal domains 上都能受益，这支持“transferable lemma”而非“局部技巧库”的说法。第二，library quality analysis：作者强调 learned library 是 compact 的，说明实验里应有库规模、去重/抽象效果、复用频次之类分析，用来证明 sleep stage 不是形式上的后处理。第三，compute efficiency：proof length 和 token usage 的下降，说明 learned lemmas 改善了搜索路径，而不是单纯靠更大采样预算换成功率。\n\n需要保守说明的是，给出的全文片段没有完整实验表和具体 baseline 出发。这些设计是在避免两类常见问题：一类是图太稀疏，采不到长工作流；另一类是图太幻觉，采样路径语义不连贯。论文强调 scenario 作为中介节点，而不是直接做 skill-to-skill 图，原因是场景层能更自然地表达“技能适用条件”和“状态转移”，也更利于后续扩展与组合。","experiments":"自动化构建结果是全文最扎实的一部分。一次全自动运行中，SkillSynth 从 demo，而是已经形成可持续扩展的数据生成底座。\n\n任务难度和多样性方面，作者把 SkillSynth 与 single-skill seed、随机组合 multi-skill seed 做比较。结果显示，SkillSynth 生成的任务更难，Claude Opus 4.6 平均需要 37 步才能解出，而且在三次独立 rollout 后仍有 121 个任务未解。这个结果说明图采样确实增加了长程依赖和技能组合复杂度，而不是只把任务写得更长。\n\n训练有效性方面，作者用合成任务上采样得到的轨迹对 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32B 做 supervised fine-tuning，并在 Terminal-Bench 1.0 与 2.0 上评测。论文结论是：图引导合成带来的轨迹多样性提升，能转化为更高的数据效率和更稳定的性能增益。给出的摘要里没有列出完整 benchmark 数字，但从正文叙述看，提升是跨模型规模一致存在的，而且不是靠单纯增加样本数，而是靠更好的任务分布。另一个值得注意的信号是，这批任务已被用于训练 Hy3 Preview，并被作者归因为其 agentic capability 提升的一部分。虽然这不是严格受控实验，但说明方法已经进入实际训练管线。","reading_guide":"泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，抓住作者为什么把轨迹拆成 scenario + skill 两层语义。这个抽象是全文成立的前提。然后重点看 skill graph 的构建流程：技能来源、pre/post scenario
